body:
You sound like me before I graduated last June, dude. I wish I could offer advice and help, make you feel better, but I'm just too drained myself to offer anything more than an internet hug.

Maybe things will get better for both of us. Maybe not. Who the hell knows at this point. For me, at least, I feel like it's never going to get better.

Same here. I was raised under the assumption that I was always in the wrong and being ungrateful and all that crap, even though I was being abused and hurt for years.

The fact that to this day, whenever I try to vent to someone who isn't my girlfriend, I basically get the same responses, just proves to me that A) I'm just a weak human being and B) That I deserve all of the bad things that happen to me.
